A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PACE research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: V1 reports original compression, runtime, ablation, and qualitative results on SemanticKITTI, Ford, nuScenes, and QNX.

after.justification: V2 retains those empirical results and adds predictor-architecture comparisons and controlled point-density experiments on Ford.

M1.justification: The preprocessing, non-causal backbone, graph-based positional encoding, elastic causal embedding, and Mamba predictor remain unchanged. The new MLP and Attention variants are experimental comparators; the existing autoregressive implementation is retained.

E1.justification: The four datasets and compression task are retained. New Appendix C introduces sparse-input scenarios by evaluating Ford point clouds at 50% and 25% density, extending input-condition coverage.

E2.justification: New Appendix B.1 evaluates MLP and Attention predictors against the default Mamba predictor. Existing codec comparator sets are retained; the density study reuses G-PCC and L3C2.

E3.justification: V2 adds an autoregressive predictor comparison on Ford and a controlled random-downsampling protocol with factors of 2 and 4. Existing dataset splits, quantization, evaluation metrics, and training budgets remain unchanged. Retraining arrangements for the density experiment are not specified.

E4.justification: Appendices B.1 and C substantially extend diagnostic evidence: one directly tests the predictor architecture's compression/runtime/memory trade-off, while the other isolates point-density sensitivity within Ford. These address previously untested design and robustness questions. Earlier component, stage-count, weight-sharing, and intrinsics analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added experiments continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Original results are retained. New appendix Table 1 reports BD-BR of -52.49%, -54.83%, and -55.07% for MLP, Attention, and Mamba. Table 5 adds density results, including FP -30.00% versus L3C2 -29.79% at 25% density. Its full-density G-PCC entry is -45.27%, slightly different from the unchanged main Table 1 D1 value of -45.24%, without explanation.

T1.justification: Equations 1–18 and the shared-versus-separate predictor parameter-count formulas retain their substance. The new architecture and density explanations introduce no formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or mathematical derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about post-causal modeling, stage scalability, compression efficiency, and over 90% autoregressive decoding-latency reduction. Added experiments support existing claims.

C2.justification: V2 explains the predictor trade-offs through MLP's restricted context and Attention's computational overhead. It also extends the existing sparsity explanation with the cost of upper-level octree structure as density falls. Earlier QNX, encoding-speed, and real-time limitations remain.

D1.justification: V2 identifies the added Attention comparator as single-layer and documents random downsampling ratios and approximate resulting point counts. Existing optimizer, hardware, training schedules, dataset splits, and autoregressive implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: V2 removes the introductory citations and reference entries for Qian et al. (2022) and Wu et al. (2021), both general 3D detection reviews. The compression-related research positioning remains unchanged; other bibliography edits mainly update metadata.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammatical and wording corrections, updates publication and equal-contribution information, adds acknowledgments, and inserts new appendix sections. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds appendix Tables 1 and 5, density-example Figure 2, and density R-D Figure 3. Existing appendix displays are relocated and renumbered. Main-text presentation remains largely stable, with small legend and caption corrections.

improvement.justification: The predictor comparison supplies direct support for choosing Mamba, and the controlled Ford experiment strengthens the earlier sparsity explanation while showing where compression advantages shrink. These targeted gains improve evidential support, despite limited new-protocol detail and the small unexplained G-PCC numerical discrepancy in appendix Table 5.
